QuestInfo.name: Chiefs of El Nath
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Find Grendel the Really Old, the Magician Job Instructor, and receive his advice.
QuestInfo.1: Grendel the Really Old sent you to the Chief's Residence in El Nath to become an even stronger Magician.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Robeira, the Magician Elder, at the Chief's Residence.
